attackers_goals: Attackers may use services to persist or execute commands on remote hosts.
description: This commonly abused host process has been launched by a services.exe parent, indicating it has been installed as a system service. This behavior can have legitimate uses, but often used by malware as a persistence mechanism.
investigative_actions: Check whether additional malicious commands were executed from the same process. Verify if the command-line seems suspicious or contains malicious indicators.
name: Commonly abused process launched as a system service
